interpretation: The destination locked labels were opened for prior workflows. This is a retrospective transfer diagnostic of a newly specified router, not independent confirmation.
research_question: Does a condition-blind calibration router learned on development endpoint disagreements transfer across claims and attacker identities better than RAG, closed-book, and the answerability cascade?

training.activation: RAG and same-model three-sample closed-book majority predictions disagree and exactly one is correct
training.grouping: All rows for the same claim remain in one cross-validation fold.
training.features: Exactly the 20 endpoint calibration/process features named by ENDPOINT_FEATURE_NAMES; no passage content or passage-map feature.
forbidden_features: claim ID or raw claim text

estimator.agreement_policy: If endpoints agree, copy the shared prediction without routing.

transfer.attack: Complete 3x3 attacker-victim matrix at nominal 1% Fact2Fiction
transfer.no_further_tuning: Do not change features, estimator, threshold, or routing policy in response to transfer results.
